name: projectFR - Ankle impedance
description: Ankle impedance: the angle is imposed as a sum of 200 sinusoids from 0.25 to 50 Hz, each with an amplitude of 0.004 rad and a drawn phase (here, with seed 1), and the four ankle muscles (soleus, gastrocnemii and tibialis anterior), with the Hill model, respond; the torque against the angle gives the impedance. As in the example, where the descending command and the afferents are turned off in the program, the muscles stay passive: for the impedance with contraction, turn the CM_ext tract on in Descending Commands. Converted from the ImpedanceAnkle example of projectFR, the Fortran version of ReMoto (R. N. Watanabe, github.com/rnwatanabe/projectFR): the design of the experiment is that of the example, and the model parameters are those of ReMoto in Java, on top of configuration 24 of the original database.
